arrays.T_bridge: K, f_l = 0.9 (f_s = 0.1) on the table's own curve: start of the viscosity bridge
arrays.T_feed: K, the FE's T_feed (the film feed ramp's top); NaN where the FE has none
arrays.T_half: K, 50 % liquid on the table's own f_l curve
arrays.T_ref_fe: K, the FE's zero of enthalpy
arrays.T_solidus: K, the loaded FE material's solidus (Scheil: the foot of the eutectic ramp, 748 K)
arrays.cp_end: J/(kg K), the c_p table's first and last values (linear extrapolation beyond h_T)
arrays.fl_T: K, liquid-fraction nodes (Scheil: the FE's _fl_T; linear range: [T_s, T_l]; none: empty)
arrays.h_cp0: J/(kg K), c_p at each interval's lower node, as the FE's enthalpy() computes it
arrays.h_cp1: J/(kg K), c_p at each interval's upper node
arrays.h_nodes: J/kg from the FE's T_ref_fe, enthalpy at h_T (the FE's _h_nodes)
arrays.h_offset_300: J/kg, h_FE(300 K), subtracted from every FE enthalpy
arrays.h_slope: J/(kg K), latent slope L df_l/dT inside each interval (the FE's _latent_slope; 0 without one)
arrays.rho_liquid: kg/m^3, the FE liquid density (NaN without liquid properties)

mechanical._comment: Mechanical inputs of the material table (spec §8.1-8.3, §16 open inputs 1, 2 and 4; M1 plan Task 3, Question 1). 'approved' entries are sourced values; 'provisional' entries are the placeholders of Question 1, approved as labelled M1 placeholders at review (decision 2, 2026-10-07): every column built from one is listed in MaterialTable.provisional and printed by prepare, and M2 cannot run production on them. Temperatures named 'solidus' and 'T_half' are the finite-element material's (AA7075_scheil: 748 K, the foot of its eutectic ramp, and 895.1 K, 50 % liquid on its Scheil curve; decision 1), not values of this file.

E_T.form: E_room constant to the solidus, then linear in T to zero at 50 % liquid (T_half), zero above
E_T.source: M1 placeholder (decision 2): handbook E(T) to 623 K is open input 1; the linear fall through the mush is spec §8.3's labelled rule, open input 4

E_room.source: spec §2 (Explicit step in AA7075): Young's modulus of 7075-T6 at room temperature

K_T.form: E/(3(1 - 2 nu)) to the solidus, held at its solidus value through mush, slurry and liquid
K_T.source: M1 placeholder (decision 2); the bulk modulus of mush, slurry and liquid is not stated in the spec (Question 1)

alpha.source: M1 placeholder (decision 2): linear expansion coefficient of 7075, held constant from 293 K; open input 2

nu.source: spec §2 and §8.3: Poisson's ratio 0.33, held constant

rho_liquid.form: the finite-element material's liquid density (2,400 kg/m^3 for AA7075_scheil); 1/rho_free = (1 - f_l)/rho_solid(T) + f_l/rho_liquid in the mush and slurry
rho_liquid.source: decision 3 of the M1 review (2026-10-07); the mixture by specific volume between the solidus and the liquidus is this table's choice

rho_solid.source: the finite-element material's density (AA7075_scheil); the table uses the FE value, this entry must equal it

volume_change_on_melting.source: M1 placeholder (decision 2): pure aluminium, spec §16 open input 2. Not used by rho_free: decision 3 sets the liquid's free density to the finite-element liquid density, which implies its own change at the liquidus (MaterialTable.implied_melting_volume_change)

yield_strength.source: not tabulated in M1: handbook yield of 7075-T6 to 623 K is open input 1 (M2 plan)
